breakdown.description: The chemical system is restricted to Ga-N, but the referenced stable-entry set is Mg-Ga-N.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains the original error. Both the prose section ('Generate the formation energy diagram for the Ga-N chemical system') and the actual code explicitly filter the stable entries to only Ga and N elements (`ga_n_elements = {'Ga', 'N'}` / `set(e.composition.elements).issubset(ga_n_elements)`), discarding the Mg-containing entries from the Mg-Ga-N file. The ground truth instead uses all entries from the Mg-Ga-N stable-entries file to build the phase diagram without restricting to the Ga-N subsystem, which is the correct resolution of the mismatch between the chemical system scope and the referenced entry set.
